name: sociavault-mcp
description: Scrape social data from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, Reddit, and ad libraries.
long_description: SociaVault gives your AI assistant live access to social media data across 11 platforms — TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Reddit, Threads, Pinterest, Twitch, and Google — with 107 tools for profiles, posts, comments, transcripts, search, trends, and ad libraries (TikTok, Meta, Google, LinkedIn). Requires a SociaVault API key.

api_key.title: SociaVault API Key
api_key.description: Your SociaVault API key (format sk_live_...). Get one at https://sociavault.com/dashboard

base_url.title: API Base URL
base_url.description: Override the API base URL. Leave as default unless you have a custom endpoint.
